references.text: Egypt's magicians do the same with their secret arts, which hardens Pharaoh's heart
The magicians also bring forth frogs with their secret arts
The magicians fail to recreate the plague of gnats and acknowledge God's finger
The magicians cannot stand before Moses because of boils
Pharaoh summons Egypt's wise men and sorcerers to interpret dreams
Nebuchadnezzar summons magicians, enchanters, sorcerers, and Chaldeans
Babylon's magic arts and astrologers are mentioned
Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, just as these oppose the truth
False signs and wonders performed to deceive people
False prophets and messiahs perform great signs and wonders
The direct narrative continuation where the sorcerers repeat Moses' signs shows the limitation of Egyptian arts before God's supremacy is fully revealed.
